name: Terraspin
abilities: Aerokinesis - hurricane-force wind gusts from shell vents
Limbs morph into spinning fan blades; generates tornadoes and corkscrew cyclones
Reverse-spin vacuum that sucks up air and toxic gas
Flight/hovering by spinning his limbs like propellers
Thick impermeable shell (high durability); retractable head and limbs
Enhanced strength (held a giant robot while spinning)
Immunity to poisonous gas; resistance to manna
weaknesses: Cumbersome and slow on the ground unless flying
Chest vents can be jammed with objects while spinning, forcing him to stop
summary: A green turtle alien whose flippers become spinning fan blades - Ben's living wind turbine, sampled from Galapagus of the Andromeda Five.
traits: Spins like a helicopter with his shell suspended
Eight shell holes in UA, six in OV
notableFeats: Destroyed a Forever Knight giant robot in his debut (Reflected Glory)
Wiped out Aggrebots aboard the Rustbucket 3 (The Forge of Creation)
Blew away Thirteen's bombs to save Julie (Inspector 13)
Sucked all the gas out of the Gas House to expose Bubble Helmet (The More Things Change: Part 2)
Rescued Azmuth and his brain (For a Few Brains More)

appearances.designNotes: Green tortoise with large flipper arms, stumpy legs, circular body, eight holes in shell, three finger-holes per flipper; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.
Slightly larger hexagonal body, six shell holes, brown spots on upper legs/toes/shoulders, thicker black eye stripes, shorter legs, three toes per foot; Omnitrix on chest.

scoring.rationale: A shell tough enough to ignore most attacks (defense 7) and hurricane winds/cyclones that shred robots and blow bombs away; can fly by spinning. Sluggish on foot, vents can be jammed, and Gwen's slow spell or electricity shut him down.

notes: UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
